sources_checked.name: Wayback Machine CMC historical pages
sources_checked.notes: DIRECT ACCESS CONFIRMED (CDX API and snapshot page fetch both HTTP 200 in this activation). Full ranking tables (rank, name, symbol, market cap, price, circulating supply, volume) retrieved via Wayback snapshots of coinmarketcap.com/historical/<YYYYMMDD>/. No API key required. 25 distinct snapshot dates with captures: 2019-12-31, 2020-01-01, 2020-01-19, 2020-02-01, 2020-03-01, 2020-06-01, 2020-08-01, 2020-09-13, 2020-11-01, 2020-12-01, 2021-01-01, 2021-02-01, 2021-04-01, 2021-05-01, 2021-06-01, 2021-08-01, 2021-09-01, 2021-12-01, 2022-01-01, 2022-05-01, 2023-01-01, 2023-10-01, 2023-12-01, 2024-01-01, 2024-04-01. Page-level sha256 checksums saved under /tmp/pit_rank_evidence/ for 18 dates (2019-12-31, 2020-01-01, 2020-01-19, 2020-02-01, 2020-08-01, 2020-09-13, 2020-11-01, 2021-02-01, 2021-05-01, 2021-06-01, 2021-08-01, 2021-09-01, 2021-12-01, 2022-01-01, 2022-05-01, 2023-01-01, 2023-12-01, 2024-01-01); CDX capture timestamps only (page fetch not re-hashed) for 2020-03-01, 2020-06-01, 2021-01-01, 2020-12-01, 2021-04-01, 2023-10-01, 2024-04-01. CDX query for 2019-12-23, 2020-10-14 returned no captures; 2020-02-04 and 2020-07-10 rate-limited/unconfirmed (not treated as no-capture). Defensible free PIT market-cap rank source at snapshot dates; coverage is snapshot-based, not continuous across every formation date.

conclusion: Final PIT rank coverage audit (2026-10-25T00:56Z). Wayback Machine CMC historical pages (coinmarketcap.com/historical/<YYYYMMDD>/) contain full point-in-time ranking tables at snapshot dates; CDX API and direct snapshot page fetch both reachable (HTTP 200). 25 distinct snapshot dates with captures: 2019-12-31, 2020-01-01, 2020-01-19, 2020-02-01, 2020-03-01, 2020-06-01, 2020-08-01, 2020-09-13, 2020-11-01, 2020-12-01, 2021-01-01, 2021-02-01, 2021-04-01, 2021-05-01, 2021-06-01, 2021-08-01, 2021-09-01, 2021-12-01, 2022-01-01, 2022-05-01, 2023-01-01, 2023-10-01, 2023-12-01, 2024-01-01, 2024-04-01. Page-level sha256 checksums saved under /tmp/pit_rank_evidence/ for 18 dates; CDX capture timestamps only for 2020-03-01, 2020-06-01, 2021-01-01, 2020-12-01, 2021-04-01, 2023-10-01, 2024-04-01. ALL formation dates now definitively checked (CDX HTTP 200, endpoint sanity-verified against known-good captures): 2019-12-23, 2020-01-06, 2020-01-15, 2020-01-17, 2020-02-04, 2020-07-10, 2020-10-14 all CONFIRMED NO CAPTURE (empty '[]' body, 3 bytes); adjacent-date checks (2020-02-03, 2020-02-05, 2020-07-09 empty; 2020-07-11 has capture) corroborate that CMC simply has no archived historical page for those specific dates. Coverage remains snapshot-based, not continuous across every formation date. Formation dates (earliest listing zip) span 2019-12-23 to 2020-10-14; several formation dates lack captures, so full point-in-time rank coverage across all formation dates is NOT achievable via free Wayback snapshots for the formation window. rank_verified remains false for all 13 symbols. Continue coverage-cohort approach; do not project current ranks backward. No rate-limited/unconfirmed dates remain.
